what: Geomagnetic storm collapses the Hydro-Québec power grid: 6 million people without power for ~9 h
HF radio blackouts, polar flights rerouted, FAA's GPS augmentation (WAAS) unusable ~30 h, power cut in Malmö (Sweden), Japanese satellite ADEOS-II lost
Intense solar radio burst makes GPS receivers on the sunlit side of Earth lose track
Hours-long HF radio blackout hits emergency communications during the Caribbean hurricane response (Irma)
Minor geomagnetic storm raises atmospheric drag: 38 of 49 new Starlink satellites re-enter
source: SpaceX 2022; Dang et al. 2022, Space Weather

what: Strongest geomagnetic storm since 2003 (G5): GPS-guided farm machinery disrupted, HF radio blackouts
